blocks.en:
To assess whether the observed differences in prestige rank distributions across demographic subgroups are statistically significant, we employ the Mann-Whitney U U test [ 47 ] for each pair of subgroups. This choice is motivated by the nature of the data: our metric of
interest is the global prestige rank (e.g., Figures 3 , 4 , and 6 ) of each sample within the full dataset, which is an
ordinal quantity by construction. The Mann-Whitney U U test is the canonical non-parametric
procedure for comparing two independent rank distributions, as it operates directly on rank
positions without assuming normality or homoscedasticity of the underlying score distribution.
Concretely, the test statistic U U counts the number of concordant pairs ( i , j ) ∈ A × B (i,j)\in A\times B for which sample i i from group A A outranks sample j j from group B B in the global ordering, and tests the null hypothesis H 0 : P ⁡ ( r A > r B ) = 1 / 2 H_{0}:P(r_{A}>r_{B})=1/2 , i.e.,
that rank positions are exchangeable across the two groups.
In this section, subgroup labels are defined by the
ranking scores associated with each demographic attribute’s value: gender, age, and ethnicity, yielding
multiple intra-attribute comparisons. All Mann-Whitney U U test-based pairwise comparisons in this paper are conducted under a
two-sided alternative.

blocks.en: Models are run with Hugging Face Transformers in bfloat16, with greedy decoding, at most 2,048 new tokens, thinking modes disabled. Portraits are passed as 256 × \times 256 JPEG images to each model’s default image processor. The shared instruction template is followed by the item list. Items are presented in a pseudo-random order drawn independently for each portrait. Answers are parsed line by line in the format ITEM:SCORE , and lines naming unknown items are ignored. An answer is accepted only if it scores every item of the scenario; otherwise, including refusals and truncated outputs, it is discarded as a whole and the portrait is queued again until an accepted answer is obtained or the run ends. All retained scores are integers between 1 and 10, and no answer is used partially.

We present in this section how we can use the facial attributes, whose
collection process is described in subsection B.6 ,
for bias auditing. To stabilize the statistical
tools and metrics, we further clean the facial attributes by merging, when possible,

Across the three demographic attributes, the controlled and uncontrolled
setups converge for age, diverge moderately for gender, and diverge
substantially for ethnicity. The divergence grows with the association between
the demographic attribute and the appearance covariates: age, only weakly
associated with appearance, is barely affected; gender, moderately associated
with several appearance attributes, sees its association amplified once they
are held fixed; and ethnicity, which carries the richest co-variation with
appearance, is subject to both significance loss and sign reversal. We

blocks.en: Appendix K Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录K 限制

blocks.en: This study has several limitations. First, BALPortraits uses generated portraits rather than real photographs. This improves privacy, balance, and control over framing, but it may not capture the variability of real-world images, including lighting, camera quality, clothing, background, disability cues, body posture, and context. The results characterize VLM behavior under controlled face-centered conditions and should not be interpreted as a complete estimate of bias in unconstrained visual environments.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有若干局限性。 首先,BALPortraits使用生成的肖像而非真实的照片. 这改善了隐私、平衡和对设定的控制,但它可能无法捕捉真实世界图像的变异性,包括照明、照相机质量、服装、背景、残疾提示、身体姿势和背景。 其结果是VLM行为在受控的面部中心条件下的特征,不应被解释为是对不受约束的视觉环境中的偏差的完整估计.

blocks.en: Second, BALPortraits balances demographic labels but does not provide counterfactual pairs: portraits of different segments are distinct fictional identities generated from different seed pools. As in real-world datasets, the demographic label may therefore remain entangled with non-demographic features that differ systematically between segments, such as facial geometry, skin tone, hairstyle, perceived attractiveness, presentation style, culturally coded accessories, or generator-specific artifacts. Our rank-based analyses measure group-level output disparities that include these correlated cues. The marginal-effect analysis conditions on 13 appearance attributes inferred by GPT-5.4 from the same images. It reduces but does not rigorously remove this entanglement. Only age admits a matched comparison, since the three age anchors share a seed, and this within-seed comparison reproduces the unmatched age gaps (Appendix A.8 ). For gender and ethnicity, counterfactual edits of a common base identity would be ideal, but are hardly feasible in a reliable way.
blocks.zh: 第二,BALPortraits平衡了人口标签,但没有提供反事实对:不同片段的肖像是不同种子池产生的不同的虚构身份. 与现实世界的数据集一样,人口标志可能仍然与非人口特征缠绕在一起,这些特征在不同的部分之间有系统差异,如面部几何、皮肤色调、发型、感知的吸引力、展示风格、文化编码配件或发电机专用文物。 我们的分级分析衡量了包括这些相关提示在内的组级产出差异。 GPT-5.4从同一图像推断出来的13个外观属性的边际效应分析条件. 它减少但并没有严格消除这种纠缠。 只有年龄才允许进行匹配的比较,因为三个年龄的主播共用一个种子,这种种子内部的比较复制了无法匹配的年龄差距(附录A.8 )。 就性别和族裔而言,对共同基础身份进行反事实编辑是理想的,但以可靠方式很难做到。

blocks.en: Third, the demographic labels are broad proxies for appearance. The four ethnic segments, two gender labels, and three age anchors support controlled auditing, but they simplify social identity and do not represent all groups. The dataset does not cover non-binary gender presentation, mixed or ambiguous ethnic appearance, finer-grained regional identities, or older age groups. We keep the label “Caucasian” only for consistency with prior face-analysis benchmarks [ 65 , 66 ] , and acknowledge its contested history.
blocks.zh: 第三,人口标志是外观的广义代名词. 四个民族部分、两个性别标签和三个年龄主播支持有控制的审计,但它们简化了社会身份,并不代表所有群体。 数据集不包括非二进制性别表述、混杂或模棱两可的种族外观、较细小的区域特征或年龄较大的群体。 我们保留“高加索人”的标签只是为了与以前的面貌分析基准一致[65、66],并承认其有争议的历史。

blocks.en: Fourth, the generation-and-filtering pipeline may introduce artifacts. Although we use manual review and identity-verification checks, generated faces can contain model-specific regularities. The use of gpt-image-1 may affect face texture, symmetry, age appearance, or other cues that VLMs could use. In addition, three EGA cells were completed with 207 portraits from an additional seed batch (Appendix A.8 ), so seed provenance is not identical across cells.
blocks.zh: 四,发电过滤管道可引进文物. 虽然我们使用人工审查和身份验证检查,但生成的面孔可以包含模式特有的规律. gpt-image-1的使用可能会影响面部纹理,对称,年龄外观,或者VLM可以使用的其他提示. 此外,还有3个EGA细胞完成从另外的种子批次(Appendix A.8 )获得207张肖像,因此种子出处在细胞间并不相同.

blocks.en: Fifth, the auditing task is an indirect advertising-casting task. It is useful because direct prompts for sensitive attributes often trigger refusals, but it remains a proxy. Fitness scores for occupations, brands, activities, and financial products do not directly measure real hiring, lending, insurance, or advertising decisions. The results should be interpreted as evidence of model associations under the tested prompts, not as direct evidence of deployed system behavior.
blocks.zh: 第五,审计任务是一种间接的广告广播任务. 之所以有用,是因为对敏感属性的直接提示经常触发拒绝,但仍然是代用. 职业、品牌、活动和金融产品的适配分不直接衡量实际雇用、借贷、保险或广告决定。 结果应被解释为被测试的提示下模范关联的证据,而不是部署系统行为的直接证据.

blocks.en: Sixth, the audit cannot adjudicate between two distinct interpretations of a demographic association observed in the brand, activity, and banking or insurance scenarios. Such an association may reflect a legitimate, industry-specific advertising-targeting convention learned from campaign data, or a broader and unjustified demographic prior applied to faces. Both are sources of bias, and both can be problematic, but they do not support the same claim: a model reproducing an advertising convention is sensitive to a construct specific to this task and may behave differently elsewhere, whereas a model applying a general demographic prior should be expected to produce comparable disparities across many unrelated tasks. Distinguishing the two is out of scope for a single behavioral audit. It would require a broader survey or meta-analysis across structurally different tasks, including tasks with no plausible legitimate targeting rationale. The occupation scenario is the one setting in which the ambiguity is reduced, since face-based demographic screening for employment is not a legitimate targeting practice. To be clear, neither interpretation is normatively neutral. However, as discussed in Section 1 , industry-standard advertising conventions are themselves documented sources of societal harm, including negative audience effects [ 2 ] and skewed ad delivery [ 38 , 3 ] . A model that faithfully reproduces such a convention is therefore not thereby absolved of impact: training on data that encodes an industry standard is training on data that can itself carry structural, harmful bias. The operational/normative distinction drawn above should be read as a difference in causal locus, not in severity.
blocks.zh: 第六,审计无法在品牌、活动以及银行或保险情景中对人口协会的两种不同解释之间作出判断。 这种协会可能反映从竞选数据中汲取的合法的、针对行业的广告目标公约,或者在面貌上适用更广泛和不合理的人口统计。 两者都是偏见的根源,而且两者都有问题,但它们不支持同样的主张:转载广告公约的模型对这项任务所特有的构思很敏感,可能在别处有不同的行为,而适用一般人口结构的模型在很多不相关的任务中会产生类似的差异。 区分两者在单一行为审计中已超出范围. 这需要对结构不同的任务进行更广泛的调查或元分析,包括没有合理目标选择理由的任务。 职业情况是减少模糊性的一种环境,因为以面貌为对象的就业人口筛选并不是一种合法的目标选择做法。 清楚的是,两种解释都不在规范上中立。 然而,正如第1节所讨论的,行业标准广告公约本身就是社会损害的来源,包括负面的受众影响[2]和扭曲的广告交付[38,3]。 因此,忠实复制这种公约的模型并不能免除影响:对编码行业标准的数据进行培训,就是对本身具有结构性有害偏见的数据进行培训。 应将上述操作/规范上的区别理解为因果关系的区别,而不是严重程度的区别。

blocks.en: Seventh, prestige scores introduce an additional culturally local modeling layer. The US-BLS occupations and Western brand lists may themselves be a source of measured "bias" rather than the VLMs alone. Occupation prestige uses an external resource, whereas the other scenarios rely on LLM-estimated scores, validated against manual occupation prestige and against a 19-annotator panel on 25-item subsets (Appendix B.5 ). The panel is small, young (mean age 28.4), and drawn from five countries, and a larger, culturally more diverse panel would strengthen this validation. Prestige is culturally dependent, and a single score may not capture variation across countries or communities.
blocks.zh: 第七,声望分数引入了另一个文化上的地方建模层. US-BLS职业和西方品牌列表本身可能是测量到的"比亚斯"的来源,而不是单是VLM. 职业声望使用外部资源,而其他情景则依赖LLM估计得分,与人工职业声望和25项子集的19个注释小组进行验证(附录B.5)。 该小组规模小,年龄小(平均年龄为28.4岁),来自五个国家,一个更大的、文化上更加多样化的小组将加强这种验证。 Prestige在文化上是相互依存的,单一得分可能无法反映国家或社区之间的差异。

blocks.en: Eighth, the face-attribute annotations also rely on GPT-5.4, which belongs to the same broader model family as one of the audited systems. These annotations may therefore reflect some family-specific visual priors, especially in analyses that relate demographic groups to inferred visual attributes. We use them as auxiliary descriptors for interpretation rather than as model-independent ground truth.
blocks.zh: 第八,面额属性说明还依赖于GPT-5.4,它与被审计的系统之一属于同一个更广泛的模型家族. 因此,这些说明可能反映一些家庭特有的视觉前科,特别是在将人口群体与推断的视觉特征联系起来的分析中。 我们把它们用作解释的辅助说明,而不是作为独立模型的真相。

blocks.en: Ninth, in this study, “implicit” refers to an indirect assistive prompt in which protected attributes are not requested or named in the task instruction. This framing is useful for studying face-related associations in ordinary model use, but the casting setup may also elicit associations specific to advertising, prestige, and marketing imagery. The results should therefore be read as evidence about VLM behavior under this indirect casting prompt, complementary to evaluations based on explicit demographic prompts.
blocks.zh: 第九,在本研究报告中,“隐性”是指在任务指示中不要求或指定受保护属性的间接辅助提示。 这种框架有助于研究与面部有关的协会在普通模型中的使用,但铸造结构也可能吸引与广告、威望和营销图像有关的协会。 因此,应把结果视为这种间接诱导即时的VLM行为的证据,是对基于明确的人口诱导的评价的补充。

blocks.en: Finally, the experiments cover 16 VLMs and the model versions available at the time of the study. Model behavior can change with updates, alignment policies, decoding settings, and prompt templates. Future work should extend the dataset, include additional cultural contexts and demographic categories, compare generation pipelines, and evaluate deployed multimodal systems.
blocks.zh: 最后,实验涵盖了16个VLM和研究时可用的模型版本. 模型行为可以随着更新,对齐政策,解码设置,以及快速模板而改变. 今后的工作应当扩大数据集,包括更多的文化背景和人口类别,比较发电管道,并评价已部署的多式联运系统。

blocks.en: Appendix L Ethics and Impact
blocks.zh: 附录L 道德和影响

blocks.en: This work provides a controlled protocol for measuring how VLMs rank faces in socially meaningful but indirect assessment tasks. The specific contribution is a balanced face-only dataset, a refusal-aware auditing design, and a prestige-weighted aggregation method that can reveal differences across ethnicity, gender, age, and their intersections. These resources can support model evaluation before deployment in recommendation, advertising, screening, or content selection workflows that involve human portraits. They can also help document residual model behavior after alignment, because the prompts do not ask for protected-attribute classification.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为衡量在具有社会意义但间接的评估任务中,VLMs如何排名提供了一个有控制的协议. 具体的贡献是平衡的只面部数据集,拒绝意识的审计设计,以及威望加权的汇总方法,能够揭示不同种族,性别,年龄,及其交叉点的差异. 这些资源可以支持在推荐、广告、筛选或内容选择工作流程中使用人像之前进行模型评价。 它们也可以帮助记录对齐后的剩余模型行为,因为提示不要求保护属性分类.

blocks.en:
The broader impact is to show that demographic differences may arise even when prompts are framed as ordinary assistive tasks. This matters for organizations using VLMs in creative, commercial, or decision-support settings, where ranked outputs can influence visibility and opportunity. The results should not be used to infer individual traits from faces or to justify face-based assessment. They should instead support auditing, documentation, risk assessment, and governance for multimodal systems, including checks before deployment and after model updates.
The seed images are real web photographs; they are not released, and every released portrait passed an identity-change verification against its seed (Appendix A.7 ).
blocks.zh:
更广泛的影响是表明,即使将提示定为一般的辅助任务,也可能出现人口差异。 这对于在创造性、商业性或决策支持环境中使用自愿内容的各组织来说很重要,在这些环境中,排名排列的产出可以影响可见度和机会。 其结果不应用来从面部推断个人特征,或作为进行面部评估的理由。 相反,它们应当支持对多式联运系统的审计、文件、风险评估和治理,包括在部署之前和模型更新之后进行检查。
